mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face production constraints and higher costs.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the proxy shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and real GDP (GDPC1) is stagnant or decreasing, the combination signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declining and GDPC1 stagnant or decreasing
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
